verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. Collection identity is now retained independently in Policy::party_collections from explicit PartyCollection types and policy-stated partOf edges, and both collection-valued deny heads and allow carve-outs route to the one-shot evaluator even when request membership evidence is empty. Positive allow heads expand only to request-evidenced members, while zero-evidence positive collection heads also fall back. The added bridge tests exercise the real PodStore enforcement path and pin absence of unsafe conditional grants/denies. I found no blocker or major correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff. Targeted tests could not be rerun in this checkout because cargo is unavailable, so this approval relies on diff-scoped code and test inspection plus normal CI.
